label: Instructional Task 1
stem: Jordan was saving his money to buy a remote control motorcycle. He saved $45.00 from his allowance and received two checks worth $10.00 each for his birthday. Jordan also has a half dollar coin collection with 30 coins in it. If the motorcycle costs $73.00, does Jordan have enough money to buy the motorcycle?

option letters A B C D
